title: Level-20 Launch Readiness Audit
subtitle: Tiered launch: the game ships in tiers — Launch 1 = CloverVillage (levels 1–20), Launch 2 = HappyValley (21–40), Launch 3 = VoidDesert (41–60). This audit covers ONLY the first launch (CloverVillage, levels 1–20). HappyValley and VoidDesert are cataloged but DEFERRED until their launch tier.

launchPlan.label: FIRST LAUNCH — ACTIVE FOCUS
launchPlan.scope: Everything needed to ship levels 1–20. Environment is strong; the blockers are enemies, a boss, dungeon interactables, item/consumable icons, quest content, and UI/audio for this zone only.

launchPlan.label: LAUNCH 2 — DEFERRED
launchPlan.scope: Cataloged (map kit, NPCs, monsters). Audit deferred until its launch tier: would need 2–3 hostile identities + a boss, plus shared systems still missing globally.

launchPlan.label: LAUNCH 3 — DEFERRED
launchPlan.scope: Cataloged (nature, map kit, full monster roster). Audit deferred until its launch tier: would need NPC/service identities.

overall.label: CLOVERVILLAGE 1–20 · CONTENT IN PROGRESS
overall.note: All 17 file categories across 8 packs are audited and classified. For the FIRST LAUNCH specifically: CloverVillage environment, NPCs, the three playable classes, and the undead loot icon set are production-ready. The launch blockers are concentrated: a native enemy roster, a regional boss, dungeon interactables, item/consumable icons, quest content, and zone UI/audio. HappyValley and VoidDesert are deferred to their launch tiers.

playerClasses.label: 3 CLASSES ENOUGH · SKILL KITS THROUGH 20 PENDING
playerClasses.note: Warrior (264 assets), Mage (173), Archer (127) cover the first launch. Do not add classes. Complete each class's ability vocabulary through level 20 — roughly basic attack + 3 skills by level 20, largely reusing existing effects: Mage has fire/water ball + spell; Warrior has 10 numbered slash variants; Archer's normal/default arrow projectile is a notable gap.
playerClasses.missing: Per-class skill mapping through level 20 (basic attack + level 5/10/20 skills). Archer default arrow projectile asset. Full 21–60 mapping deferred with HappyValley/VoidDesert.
